label: req-author-loop
purpose: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-09 (model-evaluation-specialist; NOT RUN). Stage B of the Requirements Author retrospective (SYNTHESIS v3 §C rank 2 + D0). QUESTION: does the 2b in-run correction turn make a requirements_author run RELEASE-TRUE AND PUBLISHABLE IN ONE RUN, on persisted Author nodes, without dropping owner clauses or adding slips? Same run measures M1 (Sonnet 5 vs Opus 5.5 Author). LEVERS, one per pairwise comparison: opusLoop vs opusBase = the 2b flag ONLY (variant lever requirementsFormCorrection; same model, effort, text, nodes); sonnetBase vs opusBase = the Author model ONLY (both flag OFF). FIXED SIDE: the Reviewer on its production model (claude-sonnet-5, effort high) in every arm, rebuilt from today's pinned Requirements Reviewer row; it is a conjunct of the primary but is measured, never gated on its own (playbook Phase 0 step 2). TEXT: requirements-authoring-protocol@1.8.0 + today's Requirements Author row, identical in every arm; every arm replays in today's post-fix prompt shape (dropTemplateDirective — a byte no-op on the 2026-10-08/09 trial nodes, which are post-fix; it removes the frozen template copy from pre-fix T1's directive, as production now builds it). INSTRUMENT NOTES: tool calls are stubbed (L-R3; 8/8 answered Authors called project pov.details) — G-FID brackets the effect; the 2b step is the SHIPPING runRequirementsFormStep with production's watchdog (180 s + maxToolTurns x 30 s); the owner map (nodes N7/N8/N9/F6) is answers.md via scripts/build-row-item-map.py, placed only in a COPY of the harness row's metadata (never in a prompt). SCORER: npm run lab:leg-replay -- score --run <runDir> --experiment <this dir> (the shipping TS port; self-test reproduces stage A on all 9 gens). PRIMARY per sample = Reviewer approved AND every in-run trigger check passes (size, stray rule citations, author-actionable coverage, citations incl. item-N, owner-map clauses, lint, `{{`, 🗑) AND programViewDelivered + 500 <= 50,000 (L-R5: report.md adds +0 on approved runs, +296 'NOT RELEASED' banner on refused ones, measured on the 9 committed reports). Registry-caused coverage findings (stage A (b)) are excluded from the primary and reported as a subcount, with the strict PORT-NOTE §5 conjunct beside it. GATES and what each miss triggers: (G-PRIMARY) pooled over N7+N8+N9 (15 samples per arm): PASS iff opusLoop >= 9/15 AND opusLoop - opusBase >= 5/15 AND each of N7, N8, N9 has opusLoop >= 2/5. Basis: a per-run rate >= 0.6 gives >= 0.94 probability of success within 3 runs (the SYNTHESIS target); 9 vs 4 of 15 is Fisher one-sided p = 0.07 — this is the precision n=5/cell buys, a decision threshold, not a significance claim. MISS => the flag stays OFF; read every correction record (outcome histogram: rejected:no-improvement / regressed / sections-changed / insufficient-time) to name the next lever (message text -> prompt-construction; adoption rule -> agent-execution; size ballast -> stage-2 trim arms). INCONCLUSIVE (opusLoop 7-8/15, or difference 3-4/15) => extend N7-N9 x {opusBase, opusLoop} to n=10 before deciding (pre-registered extension, cap below). (G-CLAUSE, do not ship) per owner-map node: opusLoop dropped-clause count per sample <= the opusBase median, AND no item dropped in >= 3/5 opusLoop samples that is dropped in <= 1/5 opusBase samples. (G-FORM, do not ship) per node: opusLoop samples with any form failure (a citation finding, a live `{{`, a 🗑) <= opusBase; and 0 adopted corrections introduce one (by construction; a violation is a code fault -> agent-execution / execution-facts). (G-B/C, blind hand read, A6) opusBase vs opusLoop finals on N7/N8/N9, reader blind to arm (lab blind command; key kept in the run dir): class B (leg text adds/narrows a condition, invented row or option, item not reaching its leg) and class C (harvested state or today's branch stated), summed over the 5 samples per node: a rise of >= 2 in either class on any node => revise (flag stays OFF); >= 4 => do not ship. PLUS an UNBLINDED DIFF READ of every ADOPTED correction (author.pre-correction.md vs author.md): classify each changed sentence (ballast removed / owner-decision or binding clause removed / condition added / reworded); ANY owner-decision clause removed or condition added => revise (the adoption rule cannot see wording — WIRING-NOTE-2B §5). (G-TIME, do not ship) no opusLoop sample whose Author loop + correction exceeds 1080 s; report insufficient-time count, correction duration max and correction cost mean (estimate $0.70-1.00 per Opus correction: one full re-emission, 30-45K output + ~90K cached input). (G-FALLBACK, measured) Author calls whose served model differs from the requested one, per arm (feeds M1; a fallback appearing only in opusLoop => read its correction input). (G-TRUNC, measured) max_tokens stops and the largest single-call output vs 64,000; for M1, any max_tokens stop in an arm => that arm's model is not switched to. (G-FID, instrument, measured) opusBase median view within +-15% of the persisted Opus view (N9 51,725; N8 52,985; N7 57,520) and sonnetBase within +-15% of the Sonnet range on this objective (25.9-38.3K); outside => read 2 samples for stub effects before believing any gate. (G-REV, measured) Reviewer approve rate per arm; read every opusLoop Reviewer refusal that cites text the correction changed. (M1, measured for Steve) sonnetBase vs opusBase: primary, size, blind B/C slips, fallback, max_tokens, cost and duration. T1 (telemetry, 4 legs, no owner map: clauses use draft citations, recorded) and F6/Z1 are MEASURED, never gating. A rule found wrong is corrected for the NEXT run, never reinterpreted for this one (Protocol 16).
